evidence: Restaurant detail page for The Golden Fork shows name, cuisine (French), price range ($$$$), rating (4.5), review count (2), address (142 Grand Avenue, Downtown), description, and notable feature tags (Private Dining, Wine Pairing, Tasting Menu).

Search by name (Sakura), neighborhood (Downtown) each returned correct single match. Cuisine=Seafood + Price=$$$ + search=Ocean returned Ocean Blue only; changing search to Golden (non-matching) with same filters returned 'No restaurants found matching your criteria.'

issue: Missing/invalid field information is not identified to the user
actual: Submitting the reservation form with all fields empty, or with an invalid email (e.g. 'bademail'), silently fails to create a reservation (confirmed no reservation appears in My Reservations) but shows no error text, toast, aria-invalid attribute, or visual indication of which field(s) are missing/invalid. Only focus moves to the Name field in the empty-form case.

evidence: Created reservation at Trattoria Bella for Aug 28 2026, 19:00, 4 guests with valid contact info. Confirmation toast 'Reservation Confirmed!' and confirmation panel appeared. Reservation now shows in Upcoming (1) tab with matching restaurant, date, time, party size, status=Upcoming.

Date picker disabled all past/today dates (26th disabled since today=25th at time of test, actually today 25 and even 26 shown disabled) and allowed selection of future dates (27th, 28th). Successfully combined future date Aug 28, 2026 with available time 19:00 from restaurant's time list to create a reservation.

Applied WELCOME10 (saw '10% off' badge), removed it successfully, applied WEEKEND20 (saw '20% off' badge and toast 'Coupon Applied! 20% off weekend dining'), submitted reservation, and the resulting reservation in My Reservations shows 'Coupon applied: WEEKEND20'.

issue: Coupon eligibility rules (first-reservation, day) are not enforced
actual: WELCOME10 ('10% off your first reservation') was accepted for a second reservation made in the same session after an earlier reservation already existed, violating the first-reservation rule. WEEKEND20 ('20% off weekend dining') was accepted for Aug 27, 2026, which is a Thursday (a weekday, not a weekend), violating the day-of-week eligibility rule. Only the GROUP15 party-size rule (6+ guests) was correctly enforced, rejecting it for a 2-guest reservation with the message 'This coupon requires a party of 6 or more.'

issue: Date cannot be modified for an existing reservation
actual: The 'Modify Reservation' dialog only offers 'New Time' and 'Party Size' selectors; there is no date field/control. Changing time (19:00→18:00) and party size (4→2 Guests) worked and persisted correctly in the reservation list, but the date of an upcoming reservation cannot be changed at all.

evidence: Creating a reservation showed an immediate toast ('Reservation Confirmed!') and confirmation panel, and it appeared instantly in Upcoming without reload. Modifying a reservation showed an immediate toast ('Reservation Updated') and the list reflected new time/party size instantly in the same session.

Cancelled Ember & Smoke reservation after confirming in dialog. It was removed from Upcoming (now 1) and appears in Past (1) tab with status='Cancelled', retaining date/time/party-size/coupon details.

Modify dialog opened, changes to time/party-size saved successfully via 'Save Changes'. Cancel button opened an alertdialog 'Cancel Reservation?' requiring explicit confirmation; clicking 'Keep Reservation' left both reservations unchanged, while clicking 'Cancel Reservation' actually cancelled it.

issue: Reviews can be submitted without any completed reservation, and reservation-to-review authorization is not enforced
actual: Successfully submitted a review for 'Spice Route' restaurant despite never having made any reservation there at all (Reviews count went from 0 to 1 review immediately). Also submitted a review for 'Ember & Smoke' where the only reservation was Cancelled (not completed). No restriction based on a completed reservation, and no limit of one review per completed reservation, is enforced anywhere in the review submission flow.

evidence: Submitted reviews with star rating, visit date, name, and comment for Ember & Smoke (4 stars) and Spice Route (3 stars). Both were immediately retained and displayed in each restaurant's own Reviews list with all submitted details. Verified isolation: Ocean Blue restaurant, which received no review, still shows 'Reviews (0)' / 'No reviews yet', confirming reviews are scoped to their restaurant only.

issue: Restaurant list rating is inconsistent with detail page rating and does not update after new reviews
actual: Home page list shows a static seed rating per restaurant (e.g. The Golden Fork 4.8) which does not match the rating computed/shown on that restaurant's own detail page (4.5, derived from its 2 reviews) even before any new review was added. After submitting new reviews for Ember & Smoke (rating changed 5.0→4.5, count 1→2 on detail page) and Spice Route (rating became 3.0, count 1 on detail page), the home page restaurant list still displayed the original unchanged ratings (Ember & Smoke 4.7, Spice Route 4.4), showing the list summary is never refreshed from actual review data.

evidence: Upcoming tab and Past tab clearly separate reservations by status (Upcoming vs Cancelled). Each reservation card displays restaurant name, date, time, party size, status label, location (neighborhood, e.g. 'Little Italy'/'Warehouse District'), and applied coupon when present (e.g. 'Coupon applied: WEEKEND20'), both in Upcoming and Past/Cancelled views.
